units: <cite ref="Chagigah 5a:17">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>בשעת דּוֹחֲקוֹ</he> just when he needs it (no sooner); <cite ref="Yevamot 63a:1">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> (v. Tosaf. a. l.).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:3">Ab. II, 3</cite> <he>בשעת דָּחְקוֹ</he> when he is in need (of official protection).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:6">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ</cite> <he>מד׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00972"><he>אַזְכָּרָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: emergency, v. דְּחָק. [In later Hebr. דּוֹחַק a forced opinion or reply, v. next w.]
